projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Each project is a folder on the server’s disk. Nothing is shared and there are no accounts.
projects.copy: Same identifier as another project of the list: it is an imported copy. Both stay independent.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: The server does not answer. Check that the application is still running.
errors.HTTP_413: The file sent is too large.
errors.CROSS_ORIGIN_REFUSED: Request refused: it does not come from this application.
errors.ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: This address does not exist in the API.
errors.PROJECT_INVALID: The project file is not valid.
errors.PROJECT_PATH_ESCAPE: A path of the project leaves its folder: refused.
errors.PROJECT_OVERRIDE_INVALID: A tab dimension is not valid: it must be positive.
errors.PROJECT_SCHEMA_TOO_RECENT: This project was saved by a newer version of Pawnsmith.
errors.PROJECT_TOO_LARGE: This project exceeds the size limits.
errors.PAPER_FORMAT_UNKNOWN: This paper format is not in the calibration.
errors.CANDIDATE_NOT_CUT_OUT: This proposal is not cut out, so it cannot be kept.
errors.CANDIDATE_NO_PAIRED_IMAGE: This proposal no longer has its paired image (share archive, or missing file): nothing to cut out.
errors.CUTOUT_IMAGE_INVALID: The paired image is not a PNG the cut-out can read.
errors.CUTOUT_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The paired image is larger than a generator may send.
errors.CUTOUT_BACKGROUND_NOT_UNIFORM: The background is not plain, so the cut-out cannot remove it. Generate another proposal.
errors.CUTOUT_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: Almost nothing is left once the background is removed: no character found.
errors.ARCHIVE_REJECTED: This archive is refused: it is not a valid Pawnsmith project archive.
errors.ARCHIVE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This archive exceeds the size limits.
errors.IMPORT_DESTINATION_EXISTS: A project already has this folder name: choose another name.
errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file sent is too large.
errors.LOG_NOT_FOUND: This log file does not exist.
errors.UNIVERSE_MISMATCH: The configuration files are not of the same universe.
errors.UNIVERSE_FROZEN: This project already has proposals: its universe no longer changes. Duplicate it to change it.
errors.STYLE_FROZEN: This project already has proposals: its style no longer changes. Duplicate it to change it.
errors.STYLE_INVALID: A style needs a name and a style clause.
errors.STYLE_SHIPPED: A style shipped with the application is not removed.
errors.STYLES_INVALID: The style library file is not valid.
errors.STYLES_SCHEMA_TOO_RECENT: The style library comes from a newer version.
errors.CATALOG_INVALID: The catalogue file is not valid.
errors.CATALOG_SCHEMA_TOO_RECENT: The catalogue comes from a newer version.
errors.CATALOG_ENTRY_INVALID: The item is incomplete: it needs a value, a label in each language and a phrase for the prompt.
errors.CATALOG_ENTRY_DUPLICATE: This list already has this value.
errors.CATALOG_ENTRY_SHIPPED: An item shipped with the application is not removed.
errors.TEMPLATE_INVALID: The prompt template is not valid.
errors.TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN_TOKEN: The prompt template has an unknown token.
errors.TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_TOO_RECENT: The prompt template comes from a newer version.
errors.GENERATOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: No generator is set up: enter ComfyUI’s address.
errors.GENERATOR_ADDRESS_INVALID: This address is not accepted: http or https, without credentials or parameters.
errors.GENERATOR_URL_INVALID: The configured generator address is not valid.
errors.GENERATOR_UNREACHABLE: ComfyUI does not answer. Check that it runs at the configured address.
errors.GENERATOR_TIMEOUT: ComfyUI did not answer in time.
errors.GENERATOR_REJECTED: ComfyUI refused the request: check the workflow.
errors.GENERATOR_OUTPUT_INVALID: ComfyUI returned an image the application cannot use.
errors.WORKFLOW_INVALID: The workflow file is not valid or is missing.
errors.WORKFLOW_UNKNOWN_TOKEN: The workflow has an unknown token.
errors.WORKFLOW_SCHEMA_TOO_RECENT: The workflow comes from a newer version.
errors.BATCH_SIZE_INVALID: A batch has between 1 and 20 proposals.
errors.JOB_UNEXPECTED_ERROR: The batch stopped on an unexpected error: see the logs.
errors.SHEET_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: A size does not fit on this paper format.
errors.SHEET_EMPTY: Nothing to print: no blueprint has a kept proposal.
errors.SHEET_INPUT_INVALID: A kept image is unreadable or too large.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Internal server error: see the logs.

TabAndSocket.name: Tab and socket
TabAndSocket.hint: A tab under the feet slides into a base.

FoldedTent.name: Folded tent
FoldedTent.hint: Flaps fold out under the feet.

NoSupport.name: No support
NoSupport.hint: Nothing under the feet: glue it or stand it.

project.title: Project
project.lead: These settings apply to every blueprint of the project. Each field is saved when you leave it.
project.name: Name
project.styleFrozen: This project already has proposals: its universe and style no longer change. For another style, duplicate it.
project.duplicateLead: A new project, with the same blueprints but without their proposals.
project.styleClauseHint: In English: appended as is at the end of every prompt. A palette is said here.
project.negativeHint: What the generator should avoid. With Krea 2 Turbo, it has no effect.
project.libraryHint: Choosing a style copies it into the project: changing the library changes no project.

Backup.name: Backup
Backup.hint: The whole project, paired images included. For you.

Share.name: Share
Share.hint: Without paired images. To send to someone.
